title: Charles V to Prince Philip, minute on a Fugger exchange, 1543-1554 (DECODE R9970, catalogued as Andrea del Burgo to Gattinara, 26 Oct 1527)

plaintext.source: Nothing enciphered; the minute is in clear.

transcription.notes: Opening of both drafts and key phrases read (NOTES.md, Identification). Clear-text minute of Charles V to Prince Philip on an exchange with Anton Fugger; no cipher on any of the four surfaces.

documents.date: Undated; between 1543 and 1554 (Philip addressed as prince, acting as regent). DECODE date 26 Oct 1527 belongs to a different letter.
documents.route: Charles V (in Germany or the Low Countries) -> Prince Philip, regent in Spain

system.summary: No cipher. Clear Spanish minute; the DECODE tags (alphabet, graphic signs, numerical) fit a Roman-numeral amount with the U thousands sign.

prior_solution.where: Not needed: the record is in clear.

conditions.human_role: Supplied the DECODE login cookie earlier and posed the target with /goal from the catalogue; nothing else.

solution.what: Exact citation found in Galende Diaz p.163; no reading located in initial searches.
Retrieved all four DECODE images using repository shared authorized session.
Image order 3,1,2,4; two draft sections headed al principe. Date and sender not yet visually found.
Compared both draft openings and the repeated numeral line; headings read al principe and the numeral expression occurs after cambios / hazer otro de. Accounting notation, not a recovered cipher.
Read CSP Spain III.2 October 26–31, pp.432–449. Sanchez mentions Burgo reports but no matching Burgo/Gattinara letter or decipherment appears.
Live Cryptiana failed; cached spanish2.htm and spanish2C.htm consulted, with no matching R9970 key or reading found.
Searched harvested DECODE metadata for Burgo/Borgo/shelfmark/Gattinara: no matching sibling. R9970 lists no documents or associated records.

PARES lookup unsuccessful: one request rate limited, subsequent name search returned application search error. Full Galende PDF retrieval failed; exact p.163 citation visible only in search-index text.

Closed attempt with source-identification blocker. Four scans inspected; no sender/date/address authenticating target. Preserved excerpts and hashes, retained open catalogue entry and queued DECODE review note.

Located cached esp318/lit/galende1994.pdf; read article text, verified p.163 visually and inspected appendix overview pp.167-177. No Burgo transcription, manuscript plate or identified Burgo key; p.165 n.7 cites Carmona 1894 as a source for the Simancas list. Earlier PDF limitation resolved.
Located Carmona digitization at BNE id 0000238116 through Criptohistoria; opening returned HTTP 403. Contents unverified.
Re-inspected attached archive pages 1-3; financial drafts support source mismatch. Closed attempt under user move-on instruction with named letter unread and needing source identification.

Re-read both draft openings at full resolution: "demás de los cambios que hasta aquí se an hecho por nuestro mandado con Antonio Fucar ... hazer este cambio de CX U DCC LXX ducados de a LXV gruesos"; Emperor to Prince Philip on a Fugger exchange, principal and interest to be paid at term.
Dating: Philip born 21 May 1527, so a minute to the prince on Fugger exchanges cannot be Oct 1527; fits 1543-1554. No cipher on any surface; DECODE attribution belongs to another letter.
PARES 28 Sept: EST,LEG,1563,572 and neighbouring folios not itemised; Burgo/Gattinara search finds only PTR leg. 56 no. 50 (1509); the 1527 Burgo letter not located.

outcome.method_basis: DECODE R9970 holds a clear Spanish minute of Charles V to Prince Philip (1543-1554) about an exchange with Anton Fugger; the ciphered Burgo-Gattinara letter of 1527 catalogued under it is not on the record.
outcome.notes: Record content identified; the 1527 Burgo letter remains unlocated (needs-physical-access).
